results.title: Aftertime
results.overview: While serving time for drug trafficking, the headstrong Kristina is confronted by her son about her failure as a mother. Swept up in a storm of emotion, she is forced to face a painful truth: she hasn't only betrayed herself, but also those she loves.

results.title: Silêncio
results.overview: Valéria is an unhappy and resigned young woman, who suddenly begins to hear a mysterious voice and see herself in picturesque places, leading her to question some of her choices.

results.title: Martabat: Misi Berdarah
results.overview: A quirky group of extras determined to do anything to become famous actors or getting a bigger role in Malaysia.

results.title: Machine Vacations
results.overview: When someone prompted an A.I chat box, 1 and 0 out of curiosity, goes on vacation through the internet. They questioning love and choices that human do.

results.title: Gloss
results.overview: A young man (Cruz St. James) struggles with the emotional aftermath of being sexually assaulted.

results.title: April
results.overview: Set to a vibrant landscape, 'April' follows the emotional up-and-down journey of a full-of-life high school girl, named April (played by Celine Alva), as she navigates change, friendships, and ultimately a decision that could permanently alter her life.

results.title: Only in This World
results.overview: When an empty nester loses her ability to summon her daughter back from the afterlife, she is forced to find help from the person she resents the most: her ex- husband's mistress.

results.title: Meghalu Cheppina Prema Katha
results.overview: Varun, an aspiring musician, falls for Meghana, a tech-savvy person. Subsequently, their contrasting personalities brings them closer to nature, music, and each other.

results.title: Heavy Laden
results.overview: Halvard, a young and fatigued man, is walking towards somewhere unknown. In his trolley behind him lies a dead man. Together they encounter strange things and people who try to communicate with them.

results.title: Bottle Radha
results.overview: When his wife sends him to rehab for his alcohol addiction without consent, Radha's world shatters, fuelling his desperate escape plan. Loneliness and estrangement from his family follow as he returns to his old ways.

results.title: A Family Woman
results.overview: Suzanne comes to realize that she has come out on top of her divorce when she’s asked to do her ex-husband a favor: She helps babysit the three-year-old daughter that he fathered with the woman he left Suzanne for.

results.title: Lara
results.overview: On karaikal beach, an unidentified and completely disintegrated woman corpse was reaching the sea shore. Inspector Karthikesan start the investigation as who it is? What are the confusions in the case? Who is the killer in the end? Who was murdered? What are the obstacles in the investigation? Did he find it out? Or not is the "Lara-The Unrevealed Story" is the screenplay that describes with various twists.

results.title: Deep Dish Dimples
results.overview: When Gio, a Black trans man, calls his best friend Lazette for help burying a body, the two are pulled into an unexpected confrontation with the past. As whispers of family wounds and unresolved trauma echo through the night, Gio must face a surreal encounter with his pre-transitioned self. What begins as a desperate mission transforms into a journey of acceptance, love, and self-forgiveness, reminding us that healing comes from embracing every part of who we are.

results.title: Brûlure douce
results.overview: Lou, a 16-year-old boy, is invited to spend the summer holidays at the home of Paul’s grandparents, a classmate of his. Their budding friendship grows stronger day by day, fueled by the idyllic atmosphere of the place and their work restoring an old boat they’ve decided to fix up. But what thread is this summer euphoria hanging by?

results.title: Bad B*tch
results.overview: A relentless smalltown businesswoman takes on a ruthless local gang, seeking justice and retribution as she fights to rebuild her shattered community.

results.title: Shed
results.overview: Mia, a courageous 10 year old girl who is locked in a shed, must survive inconceivable odds whilst trying to discover what happened to her family.

results.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
results.overview: Meet Lenore, a lonely maid who hates the look of her employer's nasty teeth. Overwhelmed with ick, Lenore decides to take the life of the Old Man after a beautiful dinner she made for him. Happy as can be and rotten mouth free. Her joy is interrupted when she hears a knock, a tap, tap, tapping on the chamber door.
